props.statement: Powdered catalyst adapts itself to compression and retains its form satisfactorily through reduction to the active stage and during use; reduced catalysts are usually hard, firm and brittle; where mechanical strength is insufficient, the dry filter cake is pulverized before reduction and compressed into pills (about ¼ inch in diameter and about ⅛ inch thick), which gave excellent results and in general somewhat increased yields over powdered or granular catalysts.

props.name: effect of hydrogen to carbon monoxide ratio

evidence.quote: if the ratio is below one to one by volume the S. T. Y. will be considerably lower than that obtained with hydrogen in excess by volume.
I have found that a gas containing about four volumes of hydrogen to each volume of car bon monoxide gives the best results, and that: with about 6 volumes of hydrogen the S.T. Y. is somewhat lower.

props.statement: The catalysts form methanol from any hydrogen to carbon monoxide ratio, but below one to one by volume the S.T.Y. is considerably lower; not less hydrogen than required by 2H2 + CO = CH3OH is preferred; about four volumes of hydrogen per volume of carbon monoxide gives the best results, and with about 6 volumes the S.T.Y. is somewhat lower; not more than 6 volumes is preferred for economic reasons.

props.name: active at relatively low temperature and pressure

evidence.quote: This catalyst is active under combinations of relatively low temperatures and pressures as will be noted below.

props.statement: The catalyst is active under combinations of relatively low temperatures and pressures.

props.name: meaning of non-reducible oxide

evidence.quote: In general these are oxides which are not reduced, or, at most, only to a very slight degree when a gas mixture composed of hydrogensaturated with meth
sanol is passed over them while heated to 150-300° C.

props.statement: Non-reducible oxides are oxides non-reducible or difficultly reducible under the conditions of methanol formation: in general, oxides not reduced, or only very slightly, when hydrogen saturated with methanol is passed over them at 150-300 °C.

props.statement: Within these temperatures methanol is formed in substantial amounts at pressures of 5 atmospheres and upwards, and substantial yields may even be obtained at one atmosphere, though then the S.T.Y. is so much lower that the process would not be economical; the best results are between 200 and 300 atmospheres.

evidence.quote: I have utilized various reducing gases
I prefer to reduce with hydrogen saturated at room temperature with methanol.

props.statement: Reducing gases used were hydrogen or its mixtures with carbon monoxide or methanol or both, with or without nitrogen; reduction with hydrogen saturated at room temperature with methanol is preferred, diluted with nitrogen or other inert gas to prevent uncontrollable temperature rises (for example 3 volumes hydrogen, 2 volumes methanol vapor and 95 volumes nitrogen), passed at atmospheric pressure over the dried precipitate, preferably in a copper-lined vessel, at not over 350 °C and preferably about 150-200 °C.

props.name: preferred space velocities

evidence.quote: prefer space velocities of 2,000 to 20,000, calculated at N. T. P.

props.statement: The catalysts form methanol at any space velocity; for economic reasons space velocities of 2,000 to 20,000, calculated at N.T.P., are preferred.

props.name: temperature range

evidence.quote: These catalysts are suited for the above syntheses at temperatures ranging between 150° C. and 450° C. although I have found the best results are secured between 300° C. and 400° C.

props.statement: The catalysts are suited to temperatures between 150 °C and 450 °C, the best results being secured between 300 °C and 400 °C.

props.name: wide range of conditions permissible

evidence.quote: These catalysts are of high activity and hence will operate over a large range of varying conditions, all combinations of which need not be given.
The off-gases may be recirculated, after separation of the methanol, with or without replenishment.

props.statement: The catalysts are of high activity and operate over a large range of conditions; wide limits of pressure and temperature are permissible, and temperature, space velocity and pressure may be varied to obtain the desired S.T.Y. or conversion; off-gases may be recirculated after separation of methanol, with or without replenishment.
